title: Bare-free T = 0: a bipartite 4-cycle-free graph's AND/OR edge-function circuit with no mixed OR, every edge served by a star OR, has >= |E| + tau - 1 gates
formal_statement: ∀ (p l : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin p × Fin l)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ (a a' : Fin p) (b b' : Fin l), a ≠ a' → b ≠ b' → ¬ ((a, b) ∈ E ∧ (a, b') ∈ E ∧ (a', b) ∈ E ∧ (a', b') ∈ E)) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (p + l) C → (∀ x : Fin (p + l) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (p + l) C x = decide (∃ (a : Fin p) (b : Fin l), (a, b) ∈ E ∧ x (Fin.castAdd l a) = true ∧ x (Fin.natAdd p b) = true)) → PEqualNP.TwoColour.tCount (p + l) C (fun i => decide (p ≤ i)) = 0 → (∀ (a : Fin p) (b : Fin l), (a, b) ∈ E → (∃ (j : ℕ) (Q : Finset (Fin l)), j < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ 2 ≤ Q.card ∧ b ∈ Q ∧ (∀ b' ∈ Q, (a, b') ∈ E) ∧ ∀ x : Fin (p + l) → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (p + l + j) false = decide (∃ b' ∈ Q, x (Fin.natAdd p b') = true)) ∨ (∃ (j : ℕ) (P : Finset (Fin p)), j < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ 2 ≤ P.card ∧ a ∈ P ∧ (∀ a' ∈ P, (a', b) ∈ E) ∧ ∀ x : Fin (p + l) → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (p + l + j) false = decide (∃ a' ∈ P, x (Fin.castAdd l a') = true))) → ∃ S : Finset (Fin (p + l)), (∀ (a : Fin p) (b : Fin l), (a, b) ∈ E → Fin.castAdd l a ∈ S ∨ Fin.natAdd p b ∈ S) ∧ E.card + S.card ≤ C.size + 1
plain_statement: A bipartite graph with p points, l lines, no 4-cycle, edges E. C: AND/OR gates each reading exactly two earlier wires, points then lines, computing the edge function; no OR gate reaches both a point and a line input through OR gates only (T = 0). Each edge (a, b) is served by a star OR: some OR gate is true exactly when one of at least two lines, all adjacent to a and one of them b, is on, or the same with points and lines exchanged. Then some vertex cover S has |E| + |S| <= gates of C + 1.
